title: message
description: Input schema for the litany built-in `message` tool (ARCH §2.11, §3.3, §3.4). The harness sends this verbatim as the `input_schema` field of the tool's entry in the model call's `tools: [...]` array.

agent.description: The recipient: either an agent id or a unique agent display name (ARCH §2.3, §2.11). An id is the agent's full hyphenated descent, which is also its branch name — a child's is the id its dispatch returned, and the parent's is this agent's id minus its last descent segment. A display name is the optional name an agent was dispatched with; it resolves only when exactly one living agent wears it, and an ambiguous name is refused with the candidate ids rather than guessed. The message is deposited into that agent's inbox and delivered at its next step boundary (ARCH §2.11).

content.description: The message body — content addressed to the recipient. Delivered verbatim as a user-role transcript entry at the recipient's next step boundary; steering context beside its pinned goal, not a goal rewrite (ARCH §2.8, §2.11).
